policy: References informed colony growth form, branch and corallite proportions, polyp anatomy and pigment placement only. No pixels were sampled, traced, copied or redistributed. Seller imagery was not used; trade names (staghorn, table, digitate, colour morphs) guided variant identity only. The asset is labelled at genus level (Acropora sp.) because the trade forms mix several species.

referenceGradeRationale: Genus level identity: the trade forms (staghorn, table, digitate) map to several Acropora species whose growth forms and corallite structure are well documented in taxonomic references; exact branch counts, spacing and pigments of any single colony are not calibrated to one specimen and are authored from the genus descriptions.
